## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed its scheduled imaging activity during April 2021. A total of 301 captures were recorded for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational exception was noted in the available report. Activity levels provide the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes below.

## Image quality

Of the 301 captures, 14 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.7. The result should be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to any recurring factors that may affect the usability of images. The available information does not identify a specific cause for the ungradable captures.

## Grading

There were 63 referable results during April 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. Overall, the report records completed activity, a defined level of ungradable imaging, and referable findings requiring consideration through the usual clinical pathway. The grading turnaround should continue to be monitored alongside image quality and session delivery.
